blurb: Nancy Caruso is a marine biologist and Founder of the nonprofit organization Get Inspired. Nancy has been leading restoration projects in Southern California since 2002. Her Giant Kelp Restoration Project engaged 5,000 students in growing giant kelp in their classrooms, which was later planted in the ocean by 250 trained volunteers. Ten years of hard work paid off-giant kelp forests are thriving again!
